matches.note: No reported finding covers the batch idempotency key colliding across two settlements of the same batch.
R1 and R2 both report that charge treats timeouts, 5xx and 409 errors as declines, covering the single-booking and batch paths, and that the bookings are declined while the card may be charged.
R5 reports that the PaymentIntent status is never checked, so an intent that is processing or requires_action is recorded as CAPTURED and the booking confirmed.
R3 reports that if the settle fails after a successful capture, the REQUIRES_NEW transaction rolls back and the intent id is never persisted on the CAPTURE_PENDING row.

R4 targets the same batch-level BOOKING_DEDUCTION and its non-atomicity with per-booking work, but describes a rollback-in-settle-loop mechanism rather than debit-before-charge or the lack of per-booking deductions.
Nothing reported about a card share below Stripe's minimum charge.
Nothing reported about missing Stripe SDK timeouts or retry limits.
Nothing reported about a subscribe double-click creating two paid subscriptions.
Nothing reported about a chunked request bypassing the webhook body size limit.
